subject: mathematics
concept: Finding unknown angles on a straight line (angles sum to 180 degrees)
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student combines virtual angle-wedges along a straight edge to see they total 180 degrees
exercise.pictorial: Student labels the missing angle on a pictured straight line diagram
exercise.abstract: Student calculates an unknown angle on a straight line given the other angle(s)

misconception_flags: uses 360 instead of 180 as the total for a straight line

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
